note: The Outlaw wanted set. Use card/wanted_outlaw on the room-offer screen (same 500x700 canvas as posters; can replace posters/full/showdown) and a banner when that table is chosen. The reward amount is drawn in-engine on the blank dashed line; *_example_reward files are reference only.

portrait.notes: Printed-ink bust, matches the poster; use for the duel HUD next to the HP/grit bars or wherever the Outlaw is named.

banner.notes: Announcement banner when the Showdown table is picked: slide/drop in from the top, hold ~1.5s, then shrink into the top bar. _blank has no text if you want to animate WANTED / THE OUTLAW yourself.

topbar.notes: Slim plaque for the top bar during the Showdown table (sits over the 1160-wide bar area; move the HP bar just below it).
